title: refactor(react,fields)!: retire 26 zero-consumer entry exports
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuGMYfayAZsFXYZK2K9ASCnF)_

Part of #25921. The umbrella stays open; this is barrel batch 4, claim 6667585132 (seat `domain:ui#6`, batch amendment from the seat after the census). Earlier batches: #30541, #30576, #30629.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/react` 的包入口不再导出 20 个名字,其中 7 个连同代码一起删掉(两个无人使用的动效 hook 模块 `useReducedMotion` / `useViewTransition` 及其两个类型、`useHasPageVariables`、`getShortcutDescriptions`、`AnimationTriggerType`),其余 13 个只离开入口、模块照旧;`@object-ui/fields` 的包入口不再导出 6 个名字(四个文件值辅助、筛选条件的额外运算符清单、表格列求和),模块全部保留。
- 为什么改:这 26 个名字在仓内(包外,含测试与文档)与 hotcrm 均零引用,README 未教,也不被保留导出的签名用到;被删的 7 个在包内也零读者,是死代码。本卡逐包收窄无人使用的公开导出。
- 风险与回滚:对外是 breaking 收窄,只影响直接从包入口 import 这些名字的外部宿主;控制台与所有 `@object-ui/*` 包不受影响。入口的 `export *` 改成了具名列表,反向探针证明其余 516 个名字一个不少。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/react/src/context/index.ts` 与 `ui/packages/react/src/index.ts`(`export *` 改具名列表,漏列即丢活名)、`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`(三处同类改写)、两份 `.changeset/25921-*-zero-consumer-exports.md`(迁移说明)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -l -w -e useViewTransition -e useHasPageVariables -e NoDataSourcePanel -e sumColumn -- ':!ui/packages/react' ':!ui/packages/fields' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 应只命中本 PR 的两份 changeset。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/react`, deleted (nothing inside the package read them either): the modules `src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts` (`useReducedMotion`) and `src/hooks/useViewTransition.ts` (`useViewTransition`, `ViewTransitionConfig`, `ViewTransitionResult`); the function `useHasPageVariables` from `hooks/usePageVariables.tsx`; the function `getShortcutDescriptions` from `hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts`; the type `AnimationTriggerType` from `hooks/useAnimation.ts`. Each was re-grepped on the new head: the only hits left are this PR's changeset.
- `@object-ui/react`, off the entry only (the module keeps its readers): `formatUnresolvableVisibilityMessage`, `evaluateConfigBagInScope`, `SUPPORTED_TRANSITION_PRESETS`, `SUPPORTED_EASING_FUNCTIONS`, `useOptionalTheme`, `resolveNotificationPresentation`, `SUPPORTED_NOTIFICATION_DISPLAY_TYPES`, `SUPPORTED_NOTIFICATION_POSITIONS`, `SUPPORTED_NOTIFICATION_ACTION_VARIANTS`, `HostMapStyleContext`, `RecordPagePreferencesContext`, `PrintPageContext`, `NoDataSourcePanel`. The entry reached them through `export *`, so `src/index.ts` (`SchemaRenderer.js`, `ElementDataSourceGate.js`), `src/hooks/index.ts` (`useAnimation.js`) and `src/context/index.ts` (`ThemeContext.js`, `NotificationContext.js`, `HostMapStyleContext.js`, `RecordPagePreferencesContext.js`, `PrintPageContext.js`) now name every kept export of those modules, listed from the TypeScript checker's export list; the `visibilityDiagnostic` named list drops one line.
- `@object-ui/fields`, off the entry only: `isImageValue`, `uploadResultView`, `withRecentUploads`, `FILE_STORAGE_BASE_PATH` (`widgets/file-value.ts`), `FILTER_CONDITION_EXTRA_OPERATORS` (`widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx`), `sumColumn` (`widgets/GridField.tsx`). The three `export *` lines for those modules in `src/index.tsx` become named lists of their kept exports.
- Two new changesets, `.changeset/25921-react-zero-consumer-exports.md` and `.changeset/25921-fields-zero-consumer-exports.md`: patch level, `!` title, BREAKING paragraph that says which names are gone from the package and which only left the entry, FROM/TO lines for every retired name, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` naming every operand.
- No test moves: no in-package test imports a retired name from the entry, and the deleted code had no test.

## Why

Card #25921 narrows `ui/packages` barrels to names someone imports. The checker export list after this PR is exactly the census list minus these 26 (react 324 to 304, fields 218 to 212), nothing added, and every kept name resolves to the same declaring module as before.

## Tests

Census on `origin/main` b90a6f7c with the method of batches 1 to 3: entry export names from the TypeScript checker; per name `git grep -l -w -F` outside the package, minus `**/CHANGELOG.md`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `.changeset/**` (test files count); the package `*.md` (glob, top-level README included) and `demo/`; keep rule 3 (reached from a kept export's declared signature, walked through non-exported local declarations too, which is what keeps `DropZoneConfig`); hotcrm `6961ab1`. Full table: project file `issue-25921-seat6/census-b4.md`.

| Package | Entry names | Zero outside hits | Kept (README, rule 3, or seat ruling) | Retired |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `@object-ui/react` | 324 | 104 | 84 (79 rule 3, 5 by seat ruling) | 20 |
| `@object-ui/fields` | 218 | 31 | 25 (2 README, 19 rule 3, 4 by seat ruling) | 6 |

Kept by seat ruling, zero hits notwithstanding: react `UNRESOLVABLE_ENABLEMENT_PREFIX` (the entry comment names a host contract, and its sibling `UNRESOLVABLE_VISIBILITY_PREFIX` has readers), `createLazyPlugin` / `preloadPlugin` / `LazyPluginOptions` (`content/docs/frontend/architecture-overview.mdx` teaches the module), `RELATED_CHANGED_EVENT` (plugin-detail spells its literal); fields `UploadIncompleteError` (thrown by the kept `fileValueForSubmit`), `deriveHexBadgePalette` / `HexBadgePalette` / `UrlCellRenderer` (declared in `index.tsx`, a module move).

Controls (outside hits): `SchemaRenderer` 1104, `ElementDataSourceGate` 102, `useTheme` 13, `usePageVariables` 10, `useNotifications` 9, `usePrintPage` 7, `HostMapStyleProvider` 5, `reportUnresolvableVisibilityPredicate` 3, `useRecordPagePreferences` 3, `useConfigBagEvaluator` 3, `useAnimation` 1, `useKeyboardShortcuts` 1; `isMatchAllCriteria` 10, `fileValueForSubmit` 2, `readFileValue` 2, `lookupAutofillPatch` 2; hotcrm imports `@object-ui/react` in 3 files.

Readings at c5c21494:

- Build: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` 113 of 113, VERDICT command-exit 0; then `turbo run build --force --filter=@object-ui/react --filter=@object-ui/fields` (50 of 50) and `type-check` for both (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react test`: Test Files 137 passed (137), Tests 1568 passed (1568), exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields test`: Test Files 298 passed, 1 skipped (299), Tests 4467 passed, 7 skipped (4474), exit 0.
- Reverse check on the rebuilt `.d.ts`, covering every kept name and not only the retired ones: two temporary `app-shell` probes re-exporting ALL 324 base entry names of `@object-ui/react` and all 218 of `@object-ui/fields`, `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in `ui/packages/app-shell`: exactly 26 errors (`TS2305` / `TS2724 … has no exported member`), all in the probes, and the set of names they name is identical (`diff`) to the 26 retired names; the other 516 resolved. Probes deleted; `git status` clean.
- `vitest run scripts/` (ui): Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped (172); Tests 4970 passed, 2 skipped (4972); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 29 derived, 29 run, each exit 0 captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 29 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: all 29 recorded an exit code, none is 3). `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, 0 anchored files.
- Dogfood battery (closure above plus `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock): Test Files 420 passed, 3 skipped (423); Tests 3504 passed, 36 skipped (3540); VERDICT command-exit 0 (20m45s, shared box).
- No ablation: export lines and dead declarations removed, no tested behaviour changed.
- Consumer type-check (`Type Check UI`) is CI's: no consumer imports a retired name (census), and the reverse probe reads the same rebuilt `.d.ts` the consumers read.

## Acceptance notes

- Branch name is the platform-assigned `claude/project-thread-r79zcv`, not `claude/issue-25921-*`.
- `content/docs/frontend/architecture-overview.mdx:143` says plugins are wrapped by `LazyPluginLoader`, but `createLazyPlugin` / `preloadPlugin` have no reader anywhere outside their own jsdoc test; deleting the module and correcting that paragraph is a separate decision (kept here by seat ruling).
- plugin-detail `RelatedList.tsx` and two of its tests write the `objectui:related-changed` literal instead of importing `RELATED_CHANGED_EVENT`.
- A contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue (narrowing batch); the seat runs it.
- Left for later batches: `components` (about 65 zero-hit shadcn sub-parts), `core` (about 47), `layout` / `plugin-editor` / `permissions` (1 each); fields names declared in `index.tsx` need a module move first.
